Sr i Vip in San g h i, C.J.
1. Mr. Shashank Pandey, learned counsel for the
applicant.
2. The respondent has been served through e-mail,
since the e-mail has not bounced back.
3. Despite service, none appears for the
respondent.
4. The applicant has filed a supplementary affidavit,
along with the postal receipts in relation to the notices
issued to the respondent, invoking the arbitration
agreement, from which it appears that the notices were
sent on 14.11.2022.
4. The applicant has preferred the present
Arbitration Application, under Section 11(6) of the
Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996 (the Act), to seek
appointment of a sole arbitrator to adjudicate the
disputes, which have arisen between the parties arising
out of their agreement dated 30.03.2022. The said
agreement contains an arbitration clause in Clause 3.
5. Since disputes arose between the parties under
the said agreement, the same was invoked by the
notice sent on 14.11.2022. Despite issuance of that
notice, no arbitrator has been appointed mutually by
the parties.
6. I n the light of the aforesaid, I am inclined to
allow this application.

7. Accordingly, I appoint Mr. Sandeep Kothari,
Advocate of this Court, having Mobile No. 9412912336,
to act as the sole arbitrator to adjudicate the disputes
between the parties arising out of the aforesaid
agreement.
8. The present Arbitration Application stands
disposed of in the aforesaid terms.
9. Consequently, pending applications, if any, also
stand disposed of.

( Vip in San g h i, C.J.)
